    Plan your next Prime Resurgence farm

    Varzia is a free, unofficial Warframe Aya calculator. Estimate the budget to finish your selected Prime equipment together, with one shared Aya wallet.

    1. Choose your targets and mark the parts you already own.
    2. Enter your Aya budget, squad size, and refinement strategy.
    3. Read your completion chance and the budget needed for 90% or 95% of simulated runs to finish.
    How much Aya do I need for Prime Resurgence?

    It depends on your missing parts, squad size, and refinement strategy. Enter your own situation above. P95 means about 95% of simulated runs finished all selected targets within that Aya budget; it is not a guarantee.

    What does a four-player squad mean here?

    Every squad member opens the same Void Relic at the same refinement level. You can claim one reward from the squad each mission. A mixed-Relic squad will have different odds.

    Will Varzia remember my progress?

    Your collection and current-rotation budget are saved in this browser. Bookmark this page to return. Use a live fissure session to record rewards as you play and update your remaining plan. Shared plans open as temporary previews.

    Does this calculate Regal Aya purchases or trading?

    No. This planner models Aya spent on Void Relics and their rewards. It does not model Regal Aya purchases, Platinum trading, existing Relic inventory, or the time needed to recruit a squad.

    i

    Data and model: All selected Primes share one Aya wallet. In each simulated Void Fissure Mission, you claim one reward from the squad's opened Void Relics; after each reward, the next Void Relic is chosen from the remaining missing parts. Recommendations are a heuristic based on missing parts, Relic coverage, and reward rarity, not a global optimum. Unlisted Forma and non-target rewards are represented by the remaining probability; existing Relic inventory, trading, and recruitment time are not modeled.
